successCriteria.description: ILeaveRequestService interface exposes all 9 methods: create(dto: CreateLeaveRequestDto), submit(id: string), approve(id: string, approverId: string), reject(id: string, approverId: string), cancel(id: string, cancelledBy: string), update(id: string, dto: UpdateLeaveRequestDto), getById(id: string), query(params: LeaveRequestQueryParams), getEmployeeRequests(employeeId: string)
LeaveRequestService constructor injects IEmployeeService, ILeavePolicyService, ILeaveBalanceService, and ILeaveRequestRepository as dependencies
submit() validates employee is ACTIVE via IEmployeeService.isActive, throws ValidationError if not
submit() validates the leave policy is active via ILeavePolicyService.getById, throws ValidationError if policy is inactive
submit() checks minimumNoticeDays from the policy, but skips the check when the policy's leaveType is 'emergency' (BINDING emergency bypass rule)
submit() checks for overlapping requests via ILeaveRequestRepository.findOverlapping and throws ConflictError if any overlap exists

submit() computes daysRequested = (endDate - startDate) + 1 (inclusive calendar days, integer) and checks sufficient balance via ILeaveBalanceService.getBalance; throws ValidationError if insufficient
approve() calls ILeaveBalanceService.deductDays with the same inclusive-day formula, sets approvedBy/approvedAt/status=APPROVED on the request
reject() makes no balance change, sets status=REJECTED, approvedBy, approvedAt on the request
cancel() from APPROVED status calls ILeaveBalanceService.restoreDays with the same inclusive-day formula, sets cancelledBy/cancelledAt/status=CANCELLED
cancel() from SUBMITTED status makes no balance change, sets status=CANCELLED, cancelledBy, cancelledAt
Fiscal year is derived as calendar year of startDate (startDate.getFullYear()); cross-year requests charge entirely to startDate's fiscal year — a single LeaveBalance is used

LeaveRequestController has handler methods for all 8 endpoints: createLeaveRequest, submitLeaveRequest, approveLeaveRequest, rejectLeaveRequest, cancelLeaveRequest, updateLeaveRequest, getLeaveRequest, queryLeaveRequests — each extracts input from Fastify request, calls the service, and returns the appropriate HTTP status code (201 for create, 200 for others)
Controller uses Zod schemas for request validation (body, params, query) on every handler, rejecting invalid input before the service is called
leave-request.routes.ts exports a default async Fastify plugin function that registers all 8 routes
src/modules/leave-request/index.ts barrel export re-exports from service, controller, and routes in addition to the existing model and repository re-exports

constraints: All database access must go through repository interfaces — the service must not call the pool directly or inline SQL
Service must import from sibling modules only through their index.ts barrel exports (e.g., 'modules/employee' not 'modules/employee/employee.service.ts')
